battle.automatic_battle: What happens when a wild Pokémon is beaten. 0: you choose (keys or buttons), 1: always catch, 2: always defeat for EXP, 3: catch new species and better copies of yours, otherwise defeat for EXP.
battle.cards_per_round: Cards to review per battle round (or a range, like 1-3).
battle.daily_average: How many cards you aim to review a day. Gym pacing and EXP are tuned to it: change it and the recommended values are filled in for you (you can still adjust them).
battle.card_max_time: Goal of maximum amount of time needed to answer a card in seconds
evolution.item_level_gate: Evolution stones and trade items work from Lv 16 for a first evolution and Lv 30 for a second. Off: any level.
evolution.friendship_time_enabled: Let Pokémon evolve when they reach their friendship requirement at the right time of day (day/night).
evolution.timezone_auto: Use this device's local time zone to decide day vs night for evolutions. Turn off to set a fixed UTC offset below.
evolution.timezone_offset: UTC offset in hours used for the day/night cycle when Auto-detect Time Zone is off (e.g. -5 = New York, 1 = Berlin, 5.5 = India, 0 = UTC). Ignored while auto-detect is on.
controls.pokemon_buttons: Enable action buttons for Pokémon commands during reviews.
controls.defeat_key: Key to defeat a beaten wild Pokémon (when Automatic Battle is 0).
controls.catch_key: Key to catch a beaten wild Pokémon (when Automatic Battle is 0).
controls.key_for_opening_closing_ankimon: Key to open/close Ankimon interface with control/command key. Write the keys like 'Shift+N' you can also add things like Ctrl, Shift, and multiple button combinations
controls.allow_to_choose_moves: Allows player to manually pick attack moves in battles with Keys 1-4 or fast click.
gui.animate_time: Enable a small animation for Pokémon interactions. This animation is displayed when you or the wild Pokémon is taking damage.
gui.gif_in_collection: Show animated sprites (GIFs) instead of static sprites in the collection view.
gui.styling_in_reviewer: Apply custom CSS styles to enhance reviewer visuals.
gui.hp_bar_config: Enable display HP bar for wild Pokémon.
gui.pop_up_dialog_message_on_defeat: Show a pop-up message when a wild Pokémon is defeated.
gui.review_hp_bar_thickness: Set the HP bar thickness for reviews [2: 8px, 3: 12px, 4: 16px, 5: 20px].
gui.reviewer_image_gif: Display Pokémon GIFs in the reviewer window.
gui.reviewer_text_message_box: Enable colorful pop-up messages in the reviewer.
gui.reviewer_text_message_box_time: Duration for message box display in seconds [1-5].
gui.show_mainpkmn_in_reviewer: Show main Pokémon in reviewer. [0: Hide, 1: Same level view, 2: Battle view]
gui.hud_hidden_on_startup: Hide the Heads-Up Display (HUD) when the reviewer starts.
gui.team_deck_view: Enable a quick overview of your Pokémon team at the bottom of the deck overview.
gui.view_main_front: View front of main Pokémon in reviewer when GIFs are enabled. Set Disabled to show from the back.
gui.xp_bar_config: Enable XP bar in the reviewer to show XP progression for main Pokémon.
gui.xp_bar_location: Location of the XP bar in the reviewer. [1: Top, 2: Bottom]
audio.sound_effects: Enable sound effects for various Pokémon actions.
audio.sounds: Enable general Pokémon sounds during interactions.
audio.battle_sounds: Enable recurring battle cries every 10 cards.
misc.remove_level_cap: Allow leveling beyond set level cap.
misc.language: Select language ID for Pokémon names and descriptions. [1: Japanese (Hir & Kata), 2: Japanese (Roomaji), 3: Korean, 4: Chinese (Traditional), 5: French, 6: German, 7: Spanish, 8: Italian, 9: English, 10: Czech, 11: Japanese, 12: Chinese (Simplified), 13: Portuguese (Brazil), 14: Spanish (Latin America)]
misc.ssh: Enable SSH if encountering connectivity issues (like Eduroam restrictions).
misc.leaderboard:
Enable synchronization with Ankimon leaderboard (leaderboard.ankimon.com). 
To set up, check Ankimon -> Game -> Ankimon Leaderboard and Ankimon -> Ankimon Leaderboard Credentials.
misc.ankiweb_sync:
Enable online sync of Ankimon files across devices using the same AnkiWeb email account, through the AnkiWeb sync system. 
For this to work, please enable AnkiWeb sync, and do not use the 'Delete Unused' function when checking media.
misc.YouShallNotPass_Ankimon_News: If enabled, you will not receive news pop-ups when Ankimon starts (like changelogs and updates).
misc.discord_rich_presence: Enable Discord Rich Presence for Ankimon. Shows in Discord as 'Playing Ankimon'.
misc.discord_rich_presence_text: Set to 1 for Ankimon Quotes or set to 2 for showing what Pokémon you are battle against or with
misc.show_tip_on_startup: If enabled, a window with a helpful tip about Ankimon will be shown when you start Anki!
misc.developer_mode: Enable developer mode. This will create a backup every time Anki is opened.
trainer.name: Set the name of your trainer.
trainer.cash_reward_amount: Cash you earn each time you review the number of cards below (10-400¥).
trainer.cash_reward_interval: How many cards you review for each cash reward (5-100).
gym.enabled: Gym battles are offered as you review.
gym.reviews_per_gym: Cards to review in a region before its next gym challenge. Each region keeps its own count.
gym.retry_cost_reviews: Cards to review in that region before a rematch after a loss.
gym.leader_smart_moves: Gym leaders battle smart. Off: they pick moves at random (much easier).
gym.auto_battle: Gym battles pick your moves for you. You can change this before each battle.
gym.show_battle_log: Show the gym battle log while you review.
gym.decline_cooldown_reviews: Cards to review before a gym is offered again after "Not now".
battle.defeat_xp_multiplier: EXP your Pokémon earn for defeating wild Pokémon. 1.0 = the main games' amount.
battle.capture_xp_multiplier: EXP for a catch, as a share of what defeating it would give (0.2 = a fifth, 0 = none).
gym.elite_four_classic: Face the Elite Four and Champion back to back with the same three Pokémon, healed between fights. Off: one at a time, like gyms.
battle.show_battle_popups: Show the battle log as popups while you review. Off: wild battles play out quietly.
battle.replace_duplicate_catches: Catching a better copy of a species you own replaces yours (it keeps its team slot) instead of adding a duplicate.
battle.popup_damage: The -12 HP / +8 HP numbers during wild battles. (Default: off)
battle.popup_faint: Messages when your Pokémon faints, a teammate is sent in, your whole team is worn out, or you flee. (Default: off)
battle.popup_xp: The XP gained message after a win or catch, including how the team split the EXP. (Default: off)
battle.popup_levelup: Level-up and new-move messages. Choosing which move to replace still asks you. (Default: off)
battle.popup_catch: The caught / upgraded / released message after a catch. (Default: off)
battle.wild_levels_follow_badges: Wild Pokémon get stronger as you earn badges in the region you're in. Off: they stay near your Pokémon's level.
misc.region: The region you are in: its wild Pokémon, gyms, wild levels and level cap. Change it from Ankimon > Game > Travel. (Default: Kanto)
battle.duplicate_level_window: How close in level two copies must be for better IVs to beat a higher level when deciding which to keep.
gym.showdown_engine: Gym battles follow the real games' rules. Off: a simpler engine.
gym.original_movesets: Unticked (default) = Modernized, the more balanced choice. Ticked = Original: each leader's moves from their original games.
